whats_new: A beam is now offered as finished when all its cuts have come back, not only when its metres match. Metres are the figure most often left blank, so a register full of finished beams was reporting nothing to close
Each beam on that list shows the WEIGHT received, and says whether short metres are really short or just takas nobody measured — "only 1 of 8 takas measured" instead of a beam reading 89% short
Colour coding on the list: green all cuts in, blue more takas than cuts, amber short, red short and gone quiet

Beams short on cuts are now put up for closing two ways: when the takas that would finish them are sitting unassigned, and when nothing has been booked against them for 30 days (set it in Settings — OFFER SHORT BEAMS QUIET FOR ≥)
Open any beam on that list to see its takas as a table — date, SR no., lason, act mtr, wvr mtr, taka wt, wvr wt — with totals underneath
Weaver Warping: click a beam to list the cuts booked against it, the way Office and Sizing already did. CUTS RECD. and METRES RECD. can finally be opened up

Right-click any beam in Office, Weaver or Sizing Warping to find loose takas that could be its own — matched on weaver and design, so a wrong loom number no longer hides them. A loom that differs is flagged
Production: Assign Beams (different loom) beside the existing button, for takas whose loom carries no beam while the weaver has one for that design on another loom
Assign Weaver / Assign Loom on all three warping registers, not just Sizing. Office sets weaver and loom; Weaver Warping sets the loom, since he warped the beam himself
Each party's saved address and default credit period now sync to the phone, so they show on the ledger in the Vyora app
Long ledgers can print just their oldest bills — totals stay exact
Ledger details now show the party's address and default credit period as saved in Tally
Average pay cycle: see how many days a party actually takes to pay — on the Outstanding list and above their bills, alongside the oldest bill due

Mark a bill as received while your accountant is yet to enter it in Tally — it comes off your outstanding and stays out of reminders, then clears itself once the entry lands (switch it on in Settings)
Items Stock can now be shared as a PDF — everything in one go kept group-wise, or just the group you are viewing
The version shown on the dashboard now always matches the app you have installed
Address and credit period need the Vyora Sync desktop agent on 2.0.33 or newer
